rasterize_points: rasterize a batch of point clouds into 2D images returning point indices, z-buffer, and squared distances per pixel
rasterize_points_python: run the naive pure PyTorch implementation of point cloud rasterization for debugging or CPU-only environments
_RasterizePoints_forward: build a PyTorch autograd forward pass that calls the CUDA kernel to rasterize points and save tensors for backward
_RasterizePoints_backward: run the backward pass to compute gradients with respect to point coordinates using the saved indices and z-buffer
_format_radius: create a tensor of per-point radii from a float, list, tuple, or tensor input matching the packed point count
